title: 42km : l'épreuve mythique — Marathon du Mont-Blanc (page française)
claims: The French 42 km page gives the date as Sunday 27 June 2027, the start as 06:45, the distance as 42 km and the elevation as 2,540 m D+/-.
The same page gives bib pickup at the EMC2 space on 24, 25 and 26 June 2027, by appointment only.
The same page states that the race is open from the 'Espoirs' category upwards, limited to 2,300 runners, with 6 starting waves and a 10-hour maximum time.
The same page repeats the three full feed stations plus one finish feed station, the same mandatory equipment list and the same four cut-off points as the English page.

verification.note: 2026-11-08 直取法文 42 km 页面全文。法文页已切到 2027-06-27，英文页仍停在 2026-06-28；两页其余数据一致。

claimVerification.note: 'Jeudi 24 juin 2027 de 9h à 21h'；'Vendredi 25 juin 2027 de 9h à 15h'；'Samedi 26 juin 2027 de 10h à 21h'；'uniquement sur rendez-vous'。
'Ouvert à partir de la catégorie "Espoirs"'；'Limité à 2 300 coureurs'；'6 vagues de départ'；'Temps maximum : 10 heures'。
'3 ravitaillements complets + 1 ravitaillement d'arrivée'；装备与四条 barrières horaires 与英文页一致。
